mechanism: Both drugs may increase thrombotic risk through different mechanisms (raloxifene increases coagulation factors, fluphenazine has antipsychotic effects that can contribute to hypercoagulability), and fluphenazine may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of raloxifene.
action: Monitor for signs of thromboembolism; assess bleeding/clotting status periodically and consider alternative antipsychotic if VTE risk is high.
